text: Which is an active open problem in HoTT foundations?
choices: Whether univalence is consistent with MLTT
Canonicity for Book HoTT (does axiomatic ua preserve canonicity?)
Whether S¹ is a valid HIT
explanation: Canonicity for axiomatic HoTT (does every closed ℕ-term normalise to a numeral when ua is an axiom?) is open.
